resolution: braille.lines: A and B agree on content; A's version (kept here) retains the source's own leading/internal/trailing blank braille lines verbatim (confirmed by direct re-derivation from source-lines-1390-2934.txt), matching this gold corpus's established convention (see e.g. tests/gold/bana-formats-2016/section-5's own U+2800-filler-line handling); B's version silently strips those blank lines. illustrates.quote: A's quote was correctly scoped but had a stray mid-sentence page-footer line (a running head/page-number pair from the source's own page break) spliced into the middle or end of the text; removed here.
